name: pscp-vscode
description: VS Code support for the PSCP programming language (language version 0.7).

pscp.sdkPath.description: Path to an installed `pscp.exe` or to the PSCP installation directory. Kept for compatibility; prefer `pscp.server.path` for the language server. User or machine settings only: a workspace cannot point PSCP at an executable.

pscp.languageServerPath.description: Optional direct path to `Pscp.LanguageServer.exe` or `Pscp.LanguageServer.dll`. Kept for compatibility; prefer `pscp.server.path`. User or machine settings only: a workspace cannot point PSCP at an executable.

pscp.server.path.description: Optional direct path to `Pscp.LanguageServer.exe`, `Pscp.LanguageServer.dll`, an installed `pscp.exe`, or the PSCP installation directory. User or machine settings only: a workspace cannot point PSCP at an executable.

pscp.server.args.description: Extra arguments passed to a direct language server executable.

pscp.server.trace.description: Write LSP request and notification names to the PSCP Language Server output channel. Deprecated; prefer `pscp.trace.server`.

pscp.server.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for foreground language feature requests.

pscp.transpiler.path.description: Optional direct path to `pscp.exe` for transpile/run commands. User or machine settings only: a workspace cannot point PSCP at an executable.

pscp.transpiler.args.description: Extra arguments appended to PSCP transpile/run commands.

pscp.trace.server.description: How much LSP traffic to write to the PSCP Language Server output channel.

pscp.inlayHints.types.description: Show the inferred type of a `let`/`var` binding as an inlay hint.

pscp.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter names at call sites as inlay hints.

pscp.hints.rewrite.description: Show the .NET method a data-structure rewrite operator calls.

pscp.samples.configuration.description: Build configuration for sample runs. Debug surfaces a precondition violation as an exception.

pscp.samples.timeoutMs.description: Time limit for one sample run, excluding the build.

pscp.samples.floatTolerance.description: When set, two tokens that both read as real numbers compare equal within this absolute or relative error. Unset compares exactly.

pscp.preview.pretty.description: Format the generated C# in the preview, as `pscp transpile --pretty` does.

pscp.preview.explain.description: Annotate the generated C# preview with the lowering each construct went through.

command.description: The pscp subcommand to run (for example `run` or `transpile`).

semanticTokenModifiers.description: PSCP var/mut binding or mutable field
Operator rewritten to a .NET collection call

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace only the editing features run; the transpile and run commands are disabled.
